# Muhammad Asif Javed - AI Platform Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> AI platform engineer and full-stack developer from Lahore, Pakistan, serving US, UK & international clients. Solo-architected the microservices platform behind Moburst's AI marketing suite (agency clients include Samsung, Reddit, Uber, and Google). 10+ years building real-time systems (WebRTC, Socket.io), educational technology, cybersecurity platforms, and enterprise software - end to end, as one architect.

## Key Specializations
**AI Integration & Platforms**: Multi-LLM systems (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity), microservices with SSO and 5-tier RBAC, dual-language auth SDKs, health-gated GCP deployments
**Real-time Systems**: WebRTC casting (OpenVidu), Socket.io collaboration, live whiteboards, browser-based remote control of device fleets
**Full-Stack Development**: React/Next.js frontend, Node.js and Python backends, PostgreSQL/MongoDB/MySQL
**Educational Technology**: Zero-install classroom collaboration platform built and maintained solo for ~7 years (15 teaching tools, 42 educational games)
**Cybersecurity Systems**: TIPX threat-intelligence platform integrating MISP + OpenCTI, built solo in 14 months

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Astro, Fabric.js
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, Laravel
- **AI**: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity APIs; structured output; SSO-integrated AI product suites
- **Data**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS S3, Cloudflare R2
- **DevOps**: GCP, AWS, DigitalOcean, Docker, atomic-swap deploys with automatic rollback
